document.cue: Describe a city or town you visited on holiday.

text: I want to talk about Istanbul, a big city in Turkey. I went there two years ago in the summer with my family. We stayed for one week in a small hotel near the sea, and the weather was very hot and sunny. It is a very beautiful city, and I wanted to visit it for a long time.

In Istanbul we visited many famous places. We saw the Blue Mosque and a big old market where you can buy bags, spices and sweets. I bought a small gift for my grandmother there. Every day we walked a lot and took many photos. We also took a boat trip on the sea, and it was my favourite part. The boat went between two parts of the city, and I could see old buildings and bridges. In the evening we ate fish in a restaurant and listened to music. The food was very tasty, and the people were friendly and helpful to us.

I liked this city because it is different from my city. There are many old buildings, and the streets are full of life. It was also interesting to see another culture and try new food. I felt very happy and relaxed there. Also, I practised my English with some tourists and a waiter in the restaurant, and that was good for me. I really want to go there again with my friends, because one week was too short to see everything.

tips.en: Past simple keeps the story clear.
tips.kk: Past simple әңгімені анық әрі түсінікті етеді.
tips.ru: Past simple держит рассказ чётким и понятным.
tips.example: We stayed for one week in a small hotel near the sea

tips.en: My favourite part shows a personal reaction.
tips.kk: My favourite part тіркесі жеке қатынасты көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Фраза my favourite part показывает личное отношение.
tips.example: and it was my favourite part

note.en: Names the city, the time and the company, covering the first bullets.
note.kk: Қаланы, сапар уақытын және серіктерін атайды — картаның алғашқы тармақтары.
note.ru: Называет город, время поездки и компанию — первые пункты карточки.

note.en: Lists places and activities in a simple order and adds a personal detail.
note.kk: Орындар мен іс-әрекеттерді қарапайым ретпен тізіп, жеке бөлшек қосады.
note.ru: Перечисляет места и занятия в простом порядке, добавляет личную деталь.

note.en: Explains why the city was liked and says the speaker wants to return.
note.kk: Қала неге ұнағанын түсіндіріп, қайта барғысы келетінін айтады.
note.ru: Объясняет, почему город понравился, и говорит о желании вернуться.

bullets: and explain why you liked it.
